paragraphs.text:
The stranger stumbles backward under the bullet’s impact and 
collapses  with  a  thunderstruck  grimace.  You  hurry  to  him. 
A  brief  examination  confirms  the  worst.  You  have  killed—
murdered—an  innocent  man,  probably  a  lost  woodsman  or 
prospector. You glance back at the horrified students.

If you get back to civilization, Sylvia and Norman will be 
obliged to recount what happened. Even if circumstances allow 
a manslaughter plea, how many years will that mean in prison?
Make a Sanity roll: if you fail, lose 1D6 Sanity. Then, go to 97.
